title: Hulk Hogan vs. André the Giant
summary: André challenges his former ally Hogan, with Bobby Heenan and later Ted DiBiase involved. A WrestleMania confrontation leads to a controversial televised title change.

chapters.title: Hogan defeats André
chapters.result: Hogan retains the WWF championship against André.
chapters.context: Hogan’s slam and victory provide the defining payoff to André’s challenge.

chapters.title: The disputed title change
chapters.result: André wins the championship and attempts to hand it to Ted DiBiase.
chapters.context: The controversial outcome leads to the vacant-title tournament at WrestleMania IV.
